name: Lobster Agents
tagline: A simulated 28-agent company where one front door takes every request
description: Twenty-eight Grok agents stand in as a whole company, from engineering and design to sales, legal and ops, but you never chase them individually. One front-door agent named Bob takes each request and routes it, keeping the other seats off your desk. A company simulation, and nothing acts outside your account.
author: MarcMojica
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
